integrity: Analytic proof supplied; standalone numerical tests supplement finite identities, never establish infinite conclusions. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only unshifted, uniform consecutive integer block partitions on the coefficient Hilbert space are treated. For arbitrary congruence residues the exact norm uses the spectrum of an explicit finite path Laplacian, not a radical expression. The general two-projection spectral principle is established prior work; only the modular compression and its arithmetic consequences are proposed as a new contribution. Historical priority has not been certified.
title: Arithmetic spectral law for commutators of two integer block averages
